summary: Answered Riley's question about SendMessage peer-address naming: confirmed (via this session's own get_session/list_sessions data) that a session's ListAgents/SendMessage peer name is NOT its title and isn't settable by any tool available to a persona - a cloud session's peer name is an unrelated auto-generated id that can even rotate across turns, and a local/bridge session's peer name appears tied to its physical Remote Control device registration instead. Documented in coworker/README.md with the practical mitigation (address by session_... id when it matters, otherwise default to issue #1).
